reason: Hypothesis: the all-except-MLP-expansion pattern keeps gate_proj and up_proj at 3 bits while protecting other modules at 4 bits. That targets lower weight memory than int4 while reserving precision for the modules most likely to affect extraction quality. It is a falsifiable candidate for the two-trial budget: measure extraction quality and throughput against BF16, and retain it only if both reach 95%. Existing evidence does not establish this recipe’s quality or throughput; int3-g128 measured 0.8 quality retention, while mixed3-4-g128 measured 0.85.
risk: Its likely memory and quality balance is unmeasured. The lower precision in MLP expansion may reduce constrained JSON accuracy below 95%; 4-bit protection elsewhere may raise memory enough to miss the minimum-memory objective.
